name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once' is correctly the hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) — because of the 'until', the ban lifts after one opening (the door can be shut again later and drops are then allowed), so it stays a Precedence rather than an Absence, with key_lost grounded as the drop-while-door-not-open event. 'Reach the goal.' is the unconditional hard command captured by hard Existence(at_goal), which gives the machine its final state; door_open and has_key are only ordered/restricted conditions here, so no existence clauses for them are needed, and no clause is redundant or added beyond the task.

texts: Until the door has been opened once, the key is not dropped while the door is closed.
